# Which GitHub Actions workflows run on kogany (decision K-15, plan
# docs/plans/kogany/kogany-yellowback-plan.md §0 and §5; .github/README-kogany.md says why).
#
#   <state> <file under .github/workflows/>  <reason>
#
#   kept    an upstream Zakura workflow K-15 keeps, trimmed in place (each edit carries a
#           "kogany (2026-11-01)" comment); enabled
#   called  an upstream reusable workflow (workflow_call only) a kept one calls; nothing to disable
#   off     an upstream workflow K-15 turns off. Moved, byte for byte, to .github/workflows-off/,
#           where GitHub never runs it whatever the Actions settings say; git's rename detection
#           carries an upstream edit to it across a sync (.github/README-kogany.md says why)
#   kogany  a workflow of ours; enabled
#
# `qa/kogany_audit.py workflows` (kogany-audit.yml, blocking) fails when a workflow file is not
# listed here or not in its state's directory, and when any file in .github/workflows/ has a
# trigger outside the policy (pushes only to upgrade/vault and vaults/**, pull requests only into
# upgrade/vault, vaults/** and kc/**, events only push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch
# and workflow_call), so a workflow an upstream sync adds cannot run unclassified or unfiltered.

kept    lint.yml                       K-15: clippy, rustfmt, cargo deny/vet, zizmor; without the nightly unused-deps run
kept    tests-unit.yml                 K-15: build + 3-shard nextest; without the nightly release run, its issue, and the crates.io publish-graph check
kept    zakura-e2e.yml                 K-15: the regtest pr-gate on PRs; the long four-node modes and block-sync fuzz weekly
kept    docs-check.yml                 K-15: markdownlint, codespell, lychee
kept    test-crates.yml                K-15: per-crate feature builds, weekly
kept    header-fuzz.yml                K-15: header-chain fuzzing, weekly (the Sunday campaign)
kept    rpc-fuzz.yml                   K-15: RPC fuzzing, weekly (the Sunday campaign)
called  zakura-cluster.yml             reusable: the testkit cluster job tests-unit.yml and zakura-e2e.yml call

off     ci-alerts.yml                  K-15: Slack notifier (needs a Slack webhook secret)
off     coverage.yml                   K-15: Codecov upload (needs a Codecov token)
off     benchmarks.yml                 K-15: publishes to gh-pages
off     legacy-pages.yml               K-15: upstream's Pages redirect
off     build-zakura-mac-cranelift.yml K-15: the cranelift pair (self-hosted macOS runner)
off     zakura-mac-cranelift.yml       K-15: the cranelift pair (self-hosted macOS runner)
off     cross-platform.yml             K-15: upstream's release-target matrix
off     history-growth.yml             K-15: upstream's history-growth report
off     test-docker.yml                K-15: upstream's release image
off     zcashd-compat-regtest.yml      K-15: downloads a Zcash zcashd; replaced by the sidecar leg (W9)
off     changelog.yml                  upstream's changelog-fragment policy for its release notes
off     semver-checks.yml              upstream's crates.io semver policy; kogany publishes no crate
off     create-release.yml             K-15: release pipeline
off     release-binaries.yml           K-15: release pipeline (Depot builders, Docker Hub)
off     release-drafter.yml            K-15: release pipeline
off     release-pr-readiness.yml       K-15: release pipeline (pull_request_target)
off     release-ai-review.yml          K-15: release pipeline (external review endpoint secrets)
off     release-ai-review-request.yml  K-15: release pipeline
off     prepare-release-pr.yml         K-15: release pipeline (release GitHub App)
off     publish-crates.yml             K-15: release pipeline (crates.io publishing)
off     adopt-release-state.yml        K-15: release pipeline (Mainnet release-state bundle)
off     update-release-state.yml       K-15: release pipeline (Mainnet release-state bundle)
off     zakura-mainnet-deploy.yml      K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (self-hosted deployer runner)
off     zakura-testnet-deploy.yml      K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (self-hosted deployer runner)
off     zakura-mainnet-rollback.yml    K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (self-hosted deployer runner)
off     zakura-continuous-sync.yml     K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (continuous genesis-sync hosts)
off     zakura-pr-node.yml             K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (ephemeral PR droplets)
off     zakura-pr-node-bake.yml        K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (image bake)
off     zakura-pr-node-reaper.yml      K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (resource reaper)
off     zakura-vct-handoff-canary.yml  K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (Mainnet VCT canary)
off     zakura-mempool-gossip.yml      K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (mempool experiments)
off     zakura-mempool-load.yml        K-15: DigitalOcean fleet (mempool experiments)

kogany  kogany-audit.yml               plan §5: audit legs (a)-(e), dormancy, workflow classification and triggers; one job per leg
kogany  kogany-build.yml               plan §5: cargo check ycash off/on, clippy per crate group, rustfmt
kogany  kogany-tests.yml               plan §5: kogany crates (dev/release/ci-tests), upstream crates, ycash subsets, fuzz verdicts, kogany-regtest
kogany  kogany-bin.yml                 the zakurad-bin artifact (cross-line contract); reusable
kogany  kogany-release.yml             the koganyd pre-release binaries (GitHub pre-release), on a pushed v*-ycash.* tag or dispatch only
